如何接入习惯推荐，让系统学习用户行为习惯后主动推荐应用功能？
如何接入事件推荐，根据时间和位置等信息向用户推荐提醒服务？
如何接入位置感知推荐，基于GNSS、WLAN和基站等实现室内外高精度定位推荐？
如何使用技能调用特性，让用户通过小艺对话调用应用功能？
如何实现功能一步达场景方案？
如何使用配置文件接入方式或装饰器方案接入任务执行类场景？
如何接入本地搜索，让应用内容能被小艺搜索检索到？
如何进行意图框架的联调测试和自测试？
意图标准协议和MCP协议如何上架？
intentName报错或inputParams报错如何解决？
当您希望将应用内的功能智能分发到小艺对话、小艺搜索、小艺建议等系统入口时，可使用 Intents Kit 的智慧分发能力
当您需要根据用户习惯、事件、位置等信息主动推荐应用功能时，可使用习惯推荐、事件推荐或位置推荐特性
当您希望用户通过语音对话即可调用应用功能（如搜索机票、播放音乐），或希望应用内容能被小艺搜索检索到时，可使用技能调用或本地搜索特性
接入小艺语音指令直接打开应用指定页面 / Integrate Celia voice commands to open a specific app page
实现一句话唤起应用功能并自动带入参数 / Enable one-shot invocation of app features with parameters
把应用能力注册成系统可调用的意图入口 / Register app capabilities as system-invokable intents
配置意图参数映射让系统把用户输入传给应用 / Configure intent parameter mapping so user input is passed into the app
接入一步直达服务卡片让常用操作从推荐面板启动 / Add one-step service cards so frequent actions launch from recommendation panels
让小艺能搜索到应用里的本地内容和服务 / Make app content and services discoverable in Celia search
实现语音触发下单、打车、导航等任务执行流程 / Implement voice-triggered task flows like ordering, ride hailing, or navigation
为应用功能添加意图声明和执行类以支持系统分发 / Add intent declarations and executor classes for system routing
接入基于时间地点习惯的主动服务推荐 / Integrate proactive service recommendations based on time, location, and habits
实现应用技能被系统推荐后直接拉起对应操作 / Let system recommendations deep-link into the exact app action
管理意图框架的联调、自测试和技能接入验证 / Manage intent framework debugging, self-test, and skill integration verification
通过配置文件或装饰器方式声明可被小艺调用的技能 / Declare Celia-callable skills with config files or decorators
preconditions: 工程已集成可用的 HarmonyOS Intents Kit 能力，并使用支持该能力的 API/SDK 版本 / The project has integrated the HarmonyOS Intents Kit capability and uses an API/SDK version that supports it
应用已按所选接入方式完成必要的配置文件、意图声明、域/意图元数据或装饰器基础结构 / The app has the required configuration files, intent declarations, domain/intent metadata, or decorator scaffolding for the chosen integration mode

若接入习惯推荐、事件推荐、位置推荐或搜索等系统分发能力，目标设备与系统环境支持对应入口和特性 / If integrating habit/event/location recommendations or search-based distribution, the target device and system environment support the corresponding entry points and features
inputs: 意图领域、意图名称与版本信息 / intent domain, intent name, and version information
接入方式与入口类型（配置文件、函数/Page/Link装饰器、搜索索引等） / integration mode and entry type (config file, function/Page/Link decorator, search index, etc.)
意图参数定义、槽位/输入参数及返回能力描述 / intent parameter definitions, slots/input parameters, and return capability descriptions
目标拉起对象信息（UIAbility、ServiceExtension、UIExtension、Form、srcEntry等） / target invocation object information (UIAbility, ServiceExtension, UIExtension, Form, srcEntry, etc.)

postconditions.statement: 工程中已新增或修改意图接入相关声明，使应用能力可被系统意图框架识别 / The project adds or updates intent integration declarations so the app capability can be recognized by the system intent framework
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show new or updated intent-related declarations, metadata, decorators, or configuration that expose an app capability to the HarmonyOS intent framework?

postconditions.statement: 所配置的意图与拉起目标之间建立了明确映射，包含必要字段如 domain、intentName、intentVersion 或目标入口信息 / A clear mapping is established between the configured intent and its invocation target, including required fields such as domain, intentName, intentVersion, or target entry information
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there an explicit mapping from an intent definition to a launch target or handler, with key fields like domain, intentName, intentVersion, and/or srcEntry/uiAbility/serviceExtension/uiExtension/form present?

postconditions.statement: 变更内容体现了所选场景的接入方式一致性，例如技能调用、推荐或本地搜索中的一种，而非混杂无关能力 / The changes consistently implement one chosen scenario, such as skill invocation, recommendation, or local search, rather than mixing unrelated capabilities
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits consistently correspond to a single Intents Kit integration scenario (for example skill invocation, recommendation, or local search) without primarily implementing unrelated speech, vision, or model-inference functionality?
